name: High Society
caption: A rival faction inside the promotion's own locker room that briefly seized control of the company by winning a stipulation match in February 1999.

identity.note: Name collision only with a separately-attested faction in another wing; no shared evidence.

tenures.source: Named as a locker-room faction on the promotion's own 6 January 1999 broadcast; won a stipulation match for thirty days' control of the company on 23 February 1999.

name: Team Hollywood
caption: The promotion's own president's loose banner of loyalists, defeated by the rival High Society faction's own bid for control of the company.

tenures.source: Named as the promotion's own president's own banner in the 23 February 1999 control-of-the-company stipulation match.
Named on stage at the close of the promotion's own Maplemania 2, posted 5 September 2001, welcoming Steven Erickson and Bobby Toast into its ranks.
